messages.content: I was examined for a mild ankle sprain this afternoon. The clinician checked the ankle and foot bones, said imaging was not indicated, and watched me walk. I have mild soreness only, no worsening swelling and no new symptoms. They advised a cold pack; can I put a towel between the pack and my skin?
